description: This file is a shell script used to set up and execute tests for the 'bundle-uri' command within protocol v2 testing for a Git-like system. It configures environment conditions, initiates mock servers, and runs various test cases to verify behavior related to bundle URIs over different protocols.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Sets prerequisites for the tests based on the protocol.

methods.name: start_git_daemon
methods.description: Starts a mock git daemon for testing.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts a mock HTTP server for testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: Runs the 'bundle-uri' tool with specified arguments.

methods.name: test_cmp_config_output
methods.description: Compares actual output with expected configuration output.
